text: Rename "aim" to "idea" across Aimparency, with an automatic .bowman migration
description: Felix asked (2026-10-02) how much effort renaming aims→ideas throughout the project would be, explicitly "don't start yet". Estimate recorded: ~1–2 focused days. Scale: ~400 tracked files / ~8.7k matching lines (frontend 3.9k, backend 1.6k, mcp 0.8k, wrapped-agents 0.5k), 46 files with "aim" in the path; "idea" is nearly unused in packages, so no collisions. Mechanical codemod ~2–3h (case-preserving, exclude "aimparency", "claim", English inflections like "aimed"). Real cost: (1) persisted data — 765 .bowman/aims JSONs, archived-aims, cache.db, semantic-graph.json, phase refs, field names like supportedAims, plus every linked repo's .bowman → migration + legacy-read fallback; (2) external contract — MCP tool names (create_aim, get_aim_context…) referenced in hooks, CLAUDE.md, supervisor/loop prompts, agent memory → aliases or coordinated switch; (3) git history — parseAimCommitEvidence must accept old commit format forever; (4) wrapped agents share the working tree → pause them during the 400-file commit. Semantic concern: an aim has status, phase commitment and supports other aims; "idea" connotes uncommitted, and "Aimparency" would lose its referent. Cheaper alternative: UI-label-only rename (~1–2h, no migration). Decision needed from Felix: full rename, UI-only, or keep "aim".

status.comment: Felix decided 2026-10-02: full rename to ideas, done→implemented, product name stays for now (intentree under consideration). Implemented on branch rename-aims-to-ideas (worktree ../v7-ideas, 4 commits): code rename, shared/bowman-migration with 9 tests, backend/agent-tools trigger it on first access, status history follows ideas across the rename. All checks match the pre-change baseline. Not merged: merging restarts the running stack, migrates v7/.bowman on first request and renames the MCP tools, so it waits for Felix's go.

reflection: Verification: full check suite (22 build/typecheck/test steps) equals baseline (pre-existing: 2 mcp tests Project Meta/Consistency, 3 frontend type errors); new tests: shared bowman-migration (9), backend legacy-project integration, git-evidence cross-rename history. Dry run on a copy of the real v7 .bowman: 774 ideas migrated in 0.5s, 0 conflicts, no aim-named keys left, meta statuses open/implemented/…; a sampled diff shows only state done→implemented and supportedAims→supportedIdeas. Lesson: the first codemod regex missed camelCase boundaries (calculateAimValues) — check the token report for mid-word segments before trusting a dry run.
